label: Frame the question
title: Ask who benefits from the shorter queue.
detail: Compare the average and the longest individual wait. A lower average can hide a long delay for one job.

label: Define the model
title: Make the workshop assumptions explicit.
detail: Jobs have known durations and release times. One bench handles one job at a time without interruption, with changeover between jobs.

label: Implement dispatch
title: Choose from the jobs that are ready.
detail: FCFS chooses the earliest arrival; SPT chooses the shortest ready job. Stable tie-breaking makes both repeatable, without looking at future arrivals.

label: Validate independently
artifact: Coverage, release, duration and changeover checks
title: Reject an invalid schedule before scoring it.
detail: An independent validator checks job coverage and timing constraints. A failed check blocks the waiting-time metrics.

label: Compare the experiments
title: Keep the counterexample in the result.
detail: Both policies receive identical inputs. The steady-arrival case shows lower average waiting under SPT alongside a worse longest wait.

label: Package reproducibility
title: Save enough to inspect the whole experiment.
detail: Preserve inputs, complete schedules, metrics, environment and source hash. The 9 October 2026 development record documents 36 tests and 44 feasible runs.
